RAN3 and SA2 have discussed at length the alternative QoS profiles (AQP) topic in the course of release 16 for more than a year. Finally, the final solution proposed by RAN3 was adopted and a complete set of CRs was agreed in both SA2 and RAN3 groups. These CRs foresee the sending of AQP in the format of alternative QoS parameters sets limited to GBR, PDB, PER compared to the requested QoS profile. The RAN3 CRs were submitted to RAN#88-e for approval and were agreed. While approving the SA2 CRs for release 16, SA sent an LS to RAN3 for release 17 with a question which RAN3 is asked to respond to SA2 directly. This paper provides analysis of the question and reply LS.

RAN3 has received in this meeting a reply LS [1] from SA5. In the reply LS two correction CRs to TS 28.541 are attached, namely: S5-245163: Rel-18 CR to TS 28.541 Align with TS 38.423 to introduce NRM definitions to support NR energy cost Reporting S5-245164: Rel-19 CR to TS 28.541 Align with TS 38.423 to introduce NRM definitions to support NR energy cost Reporting In the CRs, SA5 introduced NRM definitions for the NR Energy Cost mapping rule. There has been a sequence of LSs between RAN3 and SA5 on the topic of Energy Cost index and the current reply LS from SA5 [1] is related to an earlier LS sent by RAN3 to SA5 [3] in which RAN3 provided some requirements to SA5 and addressed earlier questions from SA5 on this topic. In this paper we point out some unclear aspects in the resolutions provided by SA5 and propose to send a reply LS to SA5 with our clarifications.
